name: Texas Ventures Acquisition IV Corp
summary: Texas Ventures Acquisition IV Corp. does not have significant operations. The company focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. It intends to acquire targets focused on industrial technology, such as software, mobile and IoT applications, digital and energy transition and consolidation, logistics and transportation, cloud, and cyber communications, as well as high-bandwidth services, including LTE, remote sensing, and 5G communications in the industrial sector. Texas Ventures Acquisition IV Corp. was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Houston, Texas.
